newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Ciller meets U.S. envoy on northern Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Ciller meets U.S. envoy on northern Iraq.

text.p: Turkish Foreign Minister Tansu Ciller met U.S. envoy Marc Grossman on Saturday over the latest developments in northern Iraq, where Turkey was poised to strike at rebel Kurds seeking independence from Ankara.

Ciller's office said she was expected to make a statement after the meeting, which took place amid indications that Turkey would mount a strike against the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels across the border.
The meeting was at least their third since Tuesday.

Turkish troops have been massing on the porous border with northern Iraq in apparent readiness to push against the PKK, but military officials would not confirm or deny Turkish press reports that troops had already mounted some cross-border attacks.

The United States said on Thursday it did not object to a TUrkish plan to establish a three to six mile (five to 10 km) wide security zone in northern Iraq after Ankara said it would be shortlived and not involve the stationing of Turkish troops.

Turkey says the PKK has increased activity in the volatile border region since Baghdad intervened in fighting between Iraqi Kurd rebels in northern Iraq last week and the U.S. launched cruise missile attacks against targets in southern Iraqi in retaliation.
